"""Count sampled stop actions excluded by the completed adaptation mask."""

import json
import sys
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path


def audit(path):
    run = json.loads(path.read_bytes())
    terminal = Counter()
    weighted = Counter()
    eos = {151645, 151643}
    for offset, batch in enumerate(run["replay_batches"]):
        width = len(batch["prompt_attention"][0])
        for index, row in enumerate(run["observations"][8 * offset:8 * offset + 8]):
            mixed = 0 < sum(row["rewards"]) < 4
            for sample, length in enumerate(row["lengths"]):
                sequence = batch["sequences"][4 * index + sample]
                assert length < 512 and width + length < len(sequence)
                token = sequence[width + length]
                assert token in eos
                assert len(row["masks"][sample]) == row["prompt_length"] + length
                terminal[token] += 1
                if mixed:
                    weighted[token] += 1
    assert sum(terminal.values()) == 64
    assert sum(weighted.values()) == 4 * run["gate"]["mixed_groups"] == 16
    return {"sampled_eos_after_score_mask": dict(terminal),
            "excluded_eos_with_nonzero_centered_reward": dict(weighted)}


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if not __debug__:
        raise RuntimeError("The stop audit requires Python assertions.")
    base, target = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
    result = audit(base)
    with target.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(result, stream, sort_keys=True, indent=2)
        stream.write("\n")

"""Score the paired transfer comparison independently of the GPU evaluators."""

import gzip
import hashlib
import itertools
import json
import statistics
import struct
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from audit_whole_model_replay import digest, read, verified_receipt
from ladder_audit import score


def matrix_hashes(path):
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        size, = struct.unpack("<Q", stream.read(8))
        header = json.loads(stream.read(size))
        result = {}
        for name, item in header.items():
            assert item["shape"] == [8960, 1536] and item["dtype"] == "F32"
            start, end = item["data_offsets"]
            stream.seek(8 + size + start)
            prefix = stream.read(end - start)
            assert len(prefix) == end - start == 4 * 8960 * 1536
            result[name] = hashlib.sha256(prefix).hexdigest()
    return result


def contrast(panel, candidate, comparator):
    differences = [sum(left["rewards"]) - sum(right["rewards"])
                   for left, right in zip(candidate, comparator, strict=True)]
    paired = [left + right for left, right in zip(differences[::2], differences[1::2], strict=True)]
    eligible = [value for value in paired if value != 0]
    observed = sum(paired)
    exact = [sum(sign * delta for sign, delta in zip(signs, eligible, strict=True))
             for signs in itertools.product((-1, 1), repeat=len(eligible))]
    tail = sum(result >= observed for result in exact)
    family = {name: sum(value for item, value in zip(panel, differences, strict=True) if item["family"] == name)
              for name in ("register", "packing")}
    return {"correct_difference": observed, "paired_differences": paired, "by_wording_difference": family,
            "exact_tail": tail, "exact_denominator": len(exact), "p": tail / len(exact),
            "cleared_primary_threshold": observed >= 4 and tail * 40 <= len(exact)}


def inspect(work):
    archive = work / "ladder.json.gz"
    adaptation_path, replay_path = work / "adaptation.json", work / "adaptation_replay.json"
    adapted, replay = read(adaptation_path), read(replay_path)
    assert replay["qualified"] and adapted["gate"]["passed"]
    assert replay["adaptation_sha256"] == digest(adaptation_path)
    assert all(batch["support_equal"] for batch in replay["batch_results"]) and len(replay["batch_results"]) == 2
    write_file = work / "adaptation.safetensors"
    assert digest(write_file) == replay["candidate_writes_sha256"] == adapted["candidate_writes"]["sha256"]
    weights = matrix_hashes(write_file)
    if not replay["deployed_write_bitwise"]:
        separate = work / "adaptation_replay.safetensors"
        assert digest(separate) == replay["separate_write_sha256"]
        weights.update(matrix_hashes(separate))
    panel = json.loads(gzip.decompress(archive.read_bytes()))["panels"]["panels"]["transfer"]["L1"]
    primary, reference = (read(work / name) for name in ("transfer-primary.json", "transfer-reference.json"))
    for lane in (primary, reference):
        assert lane["replay_sha256"] == digest(replay_path) and lane["zero_identity"]
        assert lane["archive_sha256"] == digest(archive) == adapted["archive_sha256"]
        assert lane["checkpoint_sha256"] == replay["checkpoint_sha256"] and lane["seed"] == 811031
    assert set(primary["arms"]) == {"compressed", "rotated", "zero"}
    expected = {"exact", "zero"} if replay["deployed_write_bitwise"] else {"exact", "replay", "zero"}
    assert set(reference["arms"]) == expected
    zero_equal = all(left["tokens"] == right["tokens"] for left, right in zip(
        primary["arms"]["zero"]["observations"], reference["arms"]["zero"]["observations"], strict=True,
    ))
    arms = {**reference["arms"], **primary["arms"]}
    details = {}
    zero = arms["zero"]["observations"]
    for name, arm in arms.items():
        rows = arm["observations"]
        audited = score(panel, rows)
        assert arm["deployed_write_sha256"] == weights.get(name)
        assert arm["summary"] == audited
        assert all(row["id"] == counterpart["id"] and row["batch_seed"] == counterpart["batch_seed"]
                   for row, counterpart in zip(rows, zero, strict=True))
        for row, control in zip(rows, zero, strict=True):
            assert row["prompt_length"] == control["prompt_length"]
            length = row["prompt_length"]
            assert [tokens[:length] for tokens in row["tokens"]] == [tokens[:length] for tokens in control["tokens"]]
        detail = {}
        for family in ("register", "packing"):
            selection = [row for item, row in zip(panel, rows, strict=True) if item["family"] == family]
            detail[family] = {"n": 4 * len(selection), "correct": sum(sum(row["rewards"]) for row in selection),
                              "parseable": sum(sum(answer is not None for answer in row["answers"]) for row in selection)}
        completions = [(length, answer) for row in rows
                       for length, answer in zip(row["lengths"], row["answers"], strict=True)]
        capped_and_unparseable = sum(length == 512 and answer is None for length, answer in completions)
        details[name] = {"score": audited, "by_wording": detail,
                         "scored_tokens": sum(length for length, _ in completions),
                         "median_scored_length": statistics.median(length for length, _ in completions),
                         "capped_and_unparseable": capped_and_unparseable}
    comparisons = {name: contrast(panel, arms["compressed"]["observations"], arms[name]["observations"])
                   for name in arms if name != "compressed"}
    qualification = all(comparisons[name]["cleared_primary_threshold"] for name in ("zero", "rotated"))
    comparable = abs(comparisons["exact"]["correct_difference"]) <= 2 if zero_equal else None
    return {"primary_passed": qualification, "comparisons": comparisons, "arms": details,
            "cross_device_zero_completions_match": zero_equal,
            "compressed_within_two_of_exact": comparable,
            "replay_reuses_exact_by_write_identity": replay["deployed_write_bitwise"],
            "verified_draws_including_duplicate_zero": 64 * (len(arms) + 1)}


def publish(work, registration, output):
    audit = inspect(work)
    assert audit == read(work / "transfer_audit.json")
    scripts = ("replay_single_write.py", "evaluate_single_write.py", "audit_single_write_transfer.py")
    sources = {name: {"sha256": digest(work / name), "content": (work / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8")} for name in scripts}
    receipts = {name: verified_receipt(work / (name + ".json")) for name in
                ("qwen-single-write-replay", "qwen-single-write-transfer-primary",
                 "qwen-single-write-transfer-reference", "qwen-single-write-transfer-audit")}
    recorded = {name: read(work / (name + ".json"))
                for name in ("adaptation_replay", "transfer-primary", "transfer-reference")}
    zipped = gzip.compress(json.dumps(recorded, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False).encode(),
                           compresslevel=9, mtime=0)
    assert json.loads(gzip.decompress(zipped)) == recorded
    report = {**audit, "registered_protocol": registration, "sources": sources, "dsr": receipts,
              "records_archive_sha256": hashlib.sha256(zipped).hexdigest(), "replay": recorded["adaptation_replay"]}
    with output.with_suffix(".json.gz").open("xb") as stream:
        stream.write(zipped)
    with output.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(report, stream, sort_keys=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if not __debug__:
        raise RuntimeError("The transfer audit requires Python assertions.")
    if sys.argv[1] == "publish":
        publish(Path(sys.argv[2]), sys.argv[3], Path(sys.argv[4]))
    else:
        directory = Path(sys.argv[1])
        result = inspect(directory)
        with (directory / "transfer_audit.json").open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            json.dump(result, stream, sort_keys=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
            stream.write("\n")

evaluate_single_write.py.content:
"""Evaluate registered single-write arms on the reserved paired transfer panel."""

import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import torch
from rich.console import Console
from safetensors.torch import load
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer

from bio_inspired_nanochat.common import stable_seed_u64
from ladder_audit import fingerprint, read, score
from qwen_external import LFS_SHA, REVISION, verify
from run_ladder import SYSTEM_PROMPT, numerical_box
from whole_model_replay import ARCHIVE_SHA, TOP_K


TRANSFER_SEED = 811031


def encode(model, tokenizer, questions):
    prompts = [tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
        [{"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM_PROMPT}, {"role": "user", "content": row["question"]}],
        tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True,
    ) for row in questions]
    return tokenizer(prompts, add_special_tokens=False, padding=True, return_tensors="pt").to(model.device)


def injector(delta):
    def apply(_, inputs, output):
        return output + (inputs[0].float() @ delta).to(output.dtype)
    return apply


@torch.inference_mode()
def verify_zero(model, tokens):
    target = model.model.layers[-1].mlp.down_proj
    zero = torch.zeros((8960, 1536), device=model.device)
    expected = model(input_ids=tokens, use_cache=False, logits_to_keep=1).logits
    handle = target.register_forward_hook(injector(zero))
    try:
        actual = model(input_ids=tokens, use_cache=False, logits_to_keep=1).logits
    finally:
        handle.remove()
    assert torch.equal(actual.view(torch.int16), expected.view(torch.int16))


@torch.inference_mode()
def sample_transfer(model, tokenizer, questions, offset):
    prefix = encode(model, tokenizer, questions)
    width = prefix.input_ids.shape[-1]
    seed = stable_seed_u64(TRANSFER_SEED, salt=f"qwen.single_write.transfer.L1.{offset}") % (2**63)
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    torch.cuda.manual_seed(seed)
    output = model.generate(
        **prefix, max_new_tokens=512, do_sample=True, temperature=1.0, top_k=TOP_K,
        top_p=1.0, repetition_penalty=1.0, num_return_sequences=4, pad_token_id=tokenizer.pad_token_id,
    )
    rows = output[:, width:].tolist()
    assert len(rows) == len(questions) * 4
    stop = model.generation_config.eos_token_id
    endings = set(stop if isinstance(stop, list) else [stop]) | {tokenizer.pad_token_id}
    result = []
    for index, row in enumerate(questions):
        prompt = prefix.input_ids[index][prefix.attention_mask[index].bool()].tolist()
        suffixes = [sample[:next((i for i, token in enumerate(sample) if token in endings), len(sample))]
                    for sample in rows[index * 4:index * 4 + 4]]
        text = tokenizer.batch_decode(suffixes, skip_special_tokens=True)
        answers = [numerical_box(response) for response in text]
        result.append({"id": row["id"], "gold": row["gold"], "text": text, "answers": answers,
                       "rewards": [int(answer == row["gold"]) for answer in answers],
                       "tokens": [prompt + suf for suf in suffixes], "lengths": list(map(len, suffixes)),
                       "masks": [[0] * len(prompt) + [1] * len(suf) for suf in suffixes],
                       "prompt_length": len(prompt), "batch_seed": seed})
    return result


def assess(model, tokenizer, panel, delta, name):
    target = model.model.layers[-1].mlp.down_proj
    handle = target.register_forward_hook(injector(delta)) if delta is not None else None
    records = []
    console = Console()
    try:
        for offset in range(0, len(panel), 8):
            records.extend(sample_transfer(model, tokenizer, panel[offset:offset + 8], offset))
            console.print(f"Transfer {name}: sampled {len(records)}/{len(panel)} questions.")
    finally:
        if handle is not None:
            handle.remove()
    return {"observations": records, "summary": score(panel, records),
            "deployed_write_sha256": hashlib.sha256(delta.cpu().numpy().tobytes()).hexdigest() if delta is not None else None}


def main(checkpoint, manifest, archive, adaptation, candidates_path, replay_path, output, arms):
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("highest")
    qualified = read(replay_path)
    prepared = read(adaptation)
    assert qualified["qualified"] and prepared["gate"]["passed"]
    assert qualified["adaptation_sha256"] == fingerprint(adaptation)
    assert qualified["candidate_writes_sha256"] == fingerprint(candidates_path) == prepared["candidate_writes"]["sha256"]
    deltas = load(candidates_path.read_bytes())
    if not qualified["deployed_write_bitwise"]:
        replay_write = replay_path.with_suffix(".safetensors")
        assert fingerprint(replay_write) == qualified["separate_write_sha256"]
        deltas.update(load(replay_write.read_bytes()))
    assert set(arms).issubset(set(deltas) | {"zero"}) and len(arms) == len(set(arms))
    assert fingerprint(archive) == ARCHIVE_SHA == prepared["archive_sha256"]
    verify(checkpoint, manifest)
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(checkpoint, local_files_only=True, trust_remote_code=False)
    tokenizer.padding_side = "left"
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(checkpoint, dtype=torch.bfloat16, local_files_only=True,
                                                trust_remote_code=False, use_safetensors=True).to("cuda").eval()
    model.requires_grad_(False)
    prompt = prepared["observations"][0]
    input_ids = torch.tensor([prompt["tokens"][0][:prompt["prompt_length"]]], device=model.device)
    verify_zero(model, input_ids)
    study = json.loads(gzip.decompress(archive.read_bytes()))
    panel = study["panels"]["panels"]["transfer"]["L1"]
    result = {"archive_sha256": ARCHIVE_SHA, "checkpoint_sha256": LFS_SHA, "checkpoint_revision": REVISION,
              "replay_sha256": fingerprint(replay_path), "seed": TRANSFER_SEED, "zero_identity": True, "arms": {},
              "gpu": torch.cuda.get_device_name()}
    for name in arms:
        delta = deltas[name].to(model.device) if name != "zero" else None
        if delta is not None:
            assert delta.shape == (8960, 1536) and delta.dtype == torch.float32
            assert abs(float(delta.double().norm()) - 0.5) <= 1e-5
        result["arms"][name] = assess(model, tokenizer, panel, delta, name)
        # Each terminal arm gets its own record even if a subsequent arm fails.
        with output.with_name(f"{output.stem}-{name}.json").open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            json.dump(result["arms"][name], stream, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":"))
            stream.write("\n")
    with output.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(result, stream, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":"))
        stream.write("\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if not __debug__:
        raise RuntimeError("The transfer comparison requires Python assertions.")
    main(*(Path(value) for value in sys.argv[1:8]), sys.argv[8:])

replay_single_write.py.content:
"""Reconstruct the adaptation write from fixed token IDs after rewards arrive."""

import hashlib
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import torch
from rich.console import Console
from safetensors.torch import load, save
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM
from transformers.cache_utils import DynamicCache

from compress_sampler_trace import indexed_groups
from ladder_audit import fingerprint, read
from qualify_single_write import deltas, support_identity
from qwen_external import LFS_SHA, REVISION, verify
from whole_model_replay import BASIS_SHA, TOP_K, errors


@torch.inference_mode()
def replay_batch(model, batch, observed):
    device = model.device
    caps = [row["lengths"][sample] for row in observed for sample in range(4)]
    limit = max(caps)
    prompt_attention = torch.tensor(batch["prompt_attention"], device=device).repeat_interleave(4, dim=0)
    width = prompt_attention.shape[1]
    sequence = torch.tensor(batch["sequences"], device=device)[:, :width + limit - 1].contiguous()
    mask = torch.cat((prompt_attention, prompt_attention.new_ones((32, limit - 1))), dim=-1)
    position = (mask.cumsum(-1) - 1).masked_fill(mask == 0, 0)
    trimmed = [tokens[row["prompt_length"]:] for row in observed for tokens in row["tokens"]]
    assert [len(tokens) for tokens in trimmed] == caps
    x, residuals, scores = [], [], []
    block = model.model.layers[-1]

    def input_hook(_, args):
        x.append(args[0][:, -1].clone())

    def residual_hook(_, _args, output):
        residuals.append(output[:, -1].clone())

    handles = (block.mlp.down_proj.register_forward_pre_hook(input_hook), block.register_forward_hook(residual_hook))
    cache = DynamicCache(config=model.config)
    try:
        for step in range(limit):
            end = width + step
            kwargs = model.prepare_inputs_for_generation(
                sequence[:, :end], next_sequence_length=1 if step else width,
                attention_mask=mask[:, :end].contiguous(), position_ids=position[:, :end],
                is_first_iteration=step == 0, past_key_values=cache, logits_to_keep=1, use_cache=True,
            )
            formed = model(**kwargs, return_dict=True)
            cache = formed.past_key_values
            logits = formed.logits[:, -1].float()
            cutoff = logits.topk(TOP_K).values[:, -1:]
            scores.append(logits.masked_fill(logits < cutoff, -torch.inf))
    finally:
        for handle in handles:
            handle.remove()
    actual = support_identity(scores, caps)
    stats = {"scored_tokens": sum(caps), "steps": limit, "expected_support_sha256": batch["support_sha256"],
             "replayed_support_sha256": actual, "support_equal": actual == batch["support_sha256"]}
    if stats["support_equal"]:
        return indexed_groups(model, x, residuals, scores, observed, trimmed), stats
    return [], stats


def main(checkpoint, manifest, adaptation, candidates_path, basis_path, output):
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("highest")
    prepared = read(adaptation)
    assert prepared["gate"]["passed"] and prepared["checkpoint_sha256"] == LFS_SHA
    assert prepared["checkpoint_revision"] == REVISION and len(prepared["replay_batches"]) == 2
    candidate_bytes = candidates_path.read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(candidate_bytes).hexdigest() == prepared["candidate_writes"]["sha256"]
    assert fingerprint(basis_path) == BASIS_SHA == prepared["canonical_basis_sha256"]
    basis = {name: value.cuda() for name, value in load(basis_path.read_bytes()).items()}
    verify(checkpoint, manifest)
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(checkpoint, dtype=torch.bfloat16, local_files_only=True,
                                                trust_remote_code=False, use_safetensors=True).to("cuda").eval()
    model.requires_grad_(False)
    report = {"adaptation_sha256": fingerprint(adaptation), "candidate_writes_sha256": fingerprint(candidates_path),
              "batch_results": [], "qualified": False, "checkpoint_sha256": LFS_SHA}
    groups = []
    console = Console()
    for index, batch in enumerate(prepared["replay_batches"]):
        data, tested = replay_batch(model, batch, prepared["observations"][index * 8:index * 8 + 8])
        report["batch_results"].append(tested)
        console.print({"replayed_batch": index, **tested})
        if not tested["support_equal"]:
            break
        groups.extend(data)
    if len(groups) == 16:
        weights, details = deltas(groups, basis)
        expected = load(candidate_bytes)["exact"].contiguous()
        actual = weights["exact"]
        error = errors(actual, expected)
        identical = torch.equal(actual.view(torch.int32), expected.view(torch.int32))
        qualified = error["relative_error"] <= 1e-4 and error["maximum_error"] <= 6e-7
        report.update({"qualified": qualified, "normalized_write": error, "deployed_write_bitwise": identical,
                       "scored_tokens": details["scored_tokens"]})
        if qualified and not identical:
            replay = save({"replay": actual})
            with output.with_suffix(".safetensors").open("xb") as stream:
                stream.write(replay)
            report["separate_write_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(replay).hexdigest()
    console.print({key: report[key] for key in ("qualified", "scored_tokens", "deployed_write_bitwise") if key in report})
    with output.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(report, stream, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False, indent=2)
        stream.write("\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if not __debug__:
        raise RuntimeError("The adaptation replay requires Python assertions.")
    main(*(Path(value) for value in sys.argv[1:]))
